text:
maya: Heads up — we just noticed a weird surge of near-duplicate paraphrases in the new paraphrase-ingest batch (batch id pbank-20270305-07). ~12k items flagged as unique but fuzzyhash shows >90% overlap.

sam: ugh. when did this start?

maya: Looks like after we switched the tokenizer to `tok-v2` for the ingest pipeline last week. The dedupe step uses token-window-based fuzzy hashing that assumed the old normalizations.

oliver: Can we repro quickly on a small subset? If tokenization changed, the fingerprinting will differ, not true semantic dups but broken fingerprint alignment.

labeler-bot: auto-flag: 12045 items with sim>0.9 to existing anchors; 11,982 marked as "unique" by pipeline.

jen: If the pipeline marked them unique, they went into the candidate pool and many landed in golden-refresh. That's bad for evals/quant bring-up.

sam: timeline: we onboard q5a quant model next Tue for smoke. If golden has these dupes, eval metrics will be biased. Need fast mitigation.

oliver: immediate plan: 1) stop new ingest for paraphrase source 2) run re-tokenize+re-hash job on suspect batches 3) generate diff list for golden picks and hold the current golden refresh.

maya: I've paused ingestion of pbank streams (done). I can kick off re-tokenize job but need the exact command to match old tokenizer normalization. Which commit/tag had tok-v1?

sam: tag is `ingest/tokenizer@v1.4.2` — that's what dedupe was built against. Use that for re-hash.

jen: Action: @oliver take ownership of re-hash job, @maya validate golden blocks, @sam coordinate labeler freeze.

oliver: will run a canary re-hash on 5k items now. command I'll use: ```
GIT_TAG=ingest/tokenizer@v1.4.2
python -m ingest.rehash --input s3://pbank/pending/2027-03-05 --tokenizer-tag $GIT_TAG --out s3://pbank/rehash-canary/2027-03-05
```

oliver: canary finished — results look promising. 4.9k items reduced to 3.2k uniques after v1 re-hash; that aligns with the fuzzy counts.

maya: Great. Next: how do we keep this from happening again when we roll tokenizers? We need a compatibility layer or a migration for dedupe anchors.

sam: Long-term: store canonical normalized text for fingerprinting in the DB (explicitly tied to tokenizer tag). Short-term: add a preflight check in ingest that compares new tokenizer hash distributions to last-known baseline; if KL divergence > threshold -> fail ingest.

jen: Also add a block in golden-refresh job: if more than X% of new golden candidates were previously in fingerprint-anchors but now show as unique, hold refresh and alert ML team.

ops: FYI I've opened INC-2027-042 for tracking and alerting on the ingest->tokenizer mismatch and added on-call paging at 4am if golden refresh triggers after-hours.

labeler-bot: queued 3.2k items for manual review (held) — labeler pool will not touch until leads release.

maya: Ok next steps: oliver runs bulk re-hash for full batch (estimate 2h), sam sets a temporary ingest guard, jen holds golden-refresh ticket until QA signoff. We'll reconvene in 50m with status. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — putting a note on the quant bring-up doc to delay smoke until we have a clean golden snapshot.

oliver: starting full re-hash now. progress: 0%. will update.

(last) oliver: full re-hash finished at 1809991310 — final unique count 3,190; pushed to s3://pbank/rehash/2027-03-05 and updated INC-2027-042.
